decisions.reason: The request for front/back matter and publication-readiness guidance does not change the cover-design state; the source message's separate cover feedback is already represented.
Requesting guidance about required front and back matter does not change the existing publisher attribution or copyright-page content.
Publication-readiness guidance does not alter Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization; the separate formatting clause in the source message is already represented.
The guidance request does not change image aspect-ratio or cropping requirements; the source message's separate image-quality observations are already represented.
The request for publishing guidance does not change which client-edited manuscript revision is authoritative; the source message's track-changes update is already represented.
Identifying publication materials and steps does not modify the manuscript's editorial-polish objective or its approved rewrites.
The general front/back matter guidance request does not establish a change to title-page content, layout, or title formatting.
Publication-readiness guidance does not alter the requirement to place images at the beginning of chapters or their integration timing.
The request for guidance on publishing materials does not change the selected chapter images or the criteria for reviewing their editorial fit.
